sourcePrimitive.action: β-adrenergic blockade administered during a reactivation window
sourcePrimitive.outsideWindowAssertion: Outside the reactivation window, β-AR blockade has no effect on the memory. The same drug administered when the memory is dormant (not retrieved) does not alter the consolidated trace. Efficacy is gated on the lability of the trace during reactivation, not on the drug being administered.
sourcePrimitive.target: memory consolidation process during plasticity window
sourcePrimitive.effect: re-consolidation is blocked during the window; memory trace is not strengthened
sourcePrimitive.targetMustBeActiveAssertion: The re-consolidation process must be active for interference to act. Re-consolidation only occurs when the memory is in the labile, reactivated state. If the trace is not reactivated, there is no re-consolidation process for the β-AR blockade to interfere with, and the drug produces no effect on memory.

portPrimitive.action: policy intervention administered during a reactivation window
portPrimitive.outsideWindowAssertion: Outside the anniversary window, the same regulatory action has no special effect. The same policy administered during a quiescent period — when markets are not actively reactivating crisis memory — produces ordinary regulatory effect but no interference with re-encoding. Efficacy is gated on the market's plasticity during reactivation, not on the policy itself.
portPrimitive.target: market re-encoding process during anniversary plasticity window
portPrimitive.effect: re-encoding of historical panic into current pricing is interfered with
portPrimitive.targetMustBeActiveAssertion: The re-encoding process must be active for interference to act. Re-encoding only occurs when market participants are observably reactivating prior crisis memory. If the trace is not reactivated — markets are quiescent, not retrieving — there is no re-encoding process for the structural signal to compete with, and the regulatory action has no special effect.

verdicts.rationale: Source primitive (action="window-intervention", effect="interference") and port primitive (action="window-intervention", effect="interference") share both structural dimensions. Transfer preserves the mechanism.
